Latest fiscal year, same formula
• Revenue — KO: $47.9B · AAPL: $478.8B
• Revenue growth — KO: +1.9% · AAPL: +15.1%
• Operating margin — KO: 28.7% · AAPL: 33.0%
• Net margin — KO: 27.3% · AAPL: 27.6%
• Free cash flow margin — KO: 11.0% · AAPL: 28.4%
• 4-year revenue growth (compound annual) — KO: 5.5% · AAPL: 5.0%

Different fiscal years: KO Dec 31, 2025 · AAPL Sep 26, 2026. The periods are not identical.
